title: IVG Pro 12 Classic Menthol Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Classic Menthol IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods deliver a no-nonsense Menthol flavour that’s bright, brisk and unmistakably cool. The clean inhale and icy exhale provide a crisp and refreshing MTL vape ideal for everyday use. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 0mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once clicked together, the refill system keeps the pod topped up as you vape — no need for refilling or coil changes. Combined, the two components can support up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on usage habits. The mesh coil ensures smooth, reliable vapour production with strong flavour delivery from start to finish. Designed for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
